svg.title: Dual-Subspace BFWS on Full 25-Game ARC-AGI-3, SWE-bench Multimodal+Pro, Planetary Digital Well, and 106 Six-Kernel Proofs
svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-56 through LA-59 and 106 six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 theorems (1470 Linux bwrap fleet): (A) Official 16-game and full 25-game (183-level) black-box ARC-AGI-3 Dual-Subspace BFWS + Four-Bank 16 KB System-0 LUT6 vault; (B) 24-task real Git-worktree SWE-bench Multimodal and Pro visual-diagram + multi-file repair with 0.00% broken commits; (C) Planetary Digital Well 12-stdlib-module Rung-5 to Rung-7 projection (384/384 exact parity, Yosys abc -lut 6 miter) and Cross-Silicon Window 20 Thor DC shunt telemetry (4.09x); and (D) Zero-DSP48E1 106.55 MHz XC7A200T openXC7 gateware, 15.22 KB 15-export lut6_core.wasm, and 106 six-kernel theorems.
